titulo.estudio: Fortelle en erfaring fra flere perspektiver

intro: Combine narrative sequence and reflection, distinguishing what you knew then from what you know now.

texto: Alternate past-tense actions with present or perfect reflections. **Da visste jeg ikke…, men i ettertid forstår jeg…** marks the shift in perspective. Keep time references clear so that the reflection doesn't seem to be something known at the time.

piezas.titulo: The first day in the workshop

frases.estudio: Først sto jeg ved døren og ventet på beskjed. De andre kjente rutinene, mens jeg prøvde å huske navnene. Etter hvert viste en kollega meg hvordan verktøyene ble registrert. Da trodde jeg at jeg bare trengte å lære systemet. I ettertid ser jeg at det viktigste var å spørre når jeg var usikker.
frases.alumno: At first I stood by the door waiting for instructions. The others knew the routines, while I was trying to remember names. Over time, a colleague showed me how tools were logged. Back then I thought I only needed to learn the system. In hindsight, I can see that the most important thing was asking when I had doubts.

pregunta.texto: What does the narrator now understand?

opciones.texto: That it was important to ask when she had doubts
opciones.explicacion: The narrator's current reflection says so explicitly.

opciones.texto: That she didn't need to learn the system
opciones.explicacion: The narrator thought learning it was enough, but now she emphasises asking.
The text says the others did know the routines.

pregunta.texto: Narrate a past experience and add a reflection that you only understand in hindsight.

textos: Da jeg begynte på kurset, prøvde jeg å forstå alt med en gang. Etter hvert lærte jeg å stille spørsmål. I ettertid ser jeg at det gjorde læringen tryggere.

piezas.explicacion: Model: temporal sequence plus current perspective, with a clear difference between the two.
